// Arcade versus map — generated by tools/mapgen/genarena.py, do not hand-edit.
//
// Every tile is placed together with its partner under a 180-degree rotation about the centre, so
// the two sides are the same ground seen from the other end. Nothing here is for sale: a
// deathmatch has no doors to buy, no box and no perks, so the map names none.
//
// Tiles    #  wall        .  floor (inside buildings)   _  street      ;  grass (walkable)
//          ,  outside the arena (nobody walks there)    =  fence (blocks walking, not bullets)
//          T  tree and  x  crate (block walking and bullets)
// Objects  1 and 2 are where the two teams start; A, B and C are the capture points;
//          b  bush (walkable, hides you from enemies more than 2 tiles away)
//          t s d o r c  furniture in the houses: table, shelf, bed (two cells), stove, barrel, chest —
//                       each blocks walking and bullets like a crate

theme forest
name FOREST
P start
1 team 0
2 team 1
A point A
B point B
C point C
b bush
t furniture table
s furniture shelf
d furniture bed
o furniture stove
r furniture barrel
c furniture chest
